headline: Today's sound headlines
lead: 30 new stories from 17 sound and audio news sources over the last 48 hours, including Sound On Sound, Production Expert, ProSoundWeb, FOH, TPi and 12 more. This edition is assembled automatically from the outlets' own feeds: titles and summaries are theirs, sorted into sections. Open a story for the full article.

items.title: Martin Audio Delivers At Chaturmas Bhakti Concert In India
items.take: Evening of devotional music and live performances at the Police Hockey Ground in Mumbai supported by a main system headed by WPC line arrays, TORUS loudspeakers, and more.

craft.body:
This month's alliance of SFX libraries is a reminder that field recordings and designed sounds have real value, including as AI training data.

Keep a simple register of your original recordings: date, place, gear, and who holds rights. When you deliver sounds to a client, say in writing whether they get a licence for this production only or full ownership. It is the same discipline the big libraries use, scaled to one person.
craft.title: Treat your own recordings as assets
